column1: # P1 fixed-CPU regions classified by the p1-lo lane. Row format:
# Kinds: fill:XX = constant run proven unreferenced; data = consumer-evidenced
# table/asset whose bytes are generated from the owner's ROM at build time.
# Evidence cites consumers (instruction addresses) or structural validation.
# Overlap with instruction sources or other rows is rejected by gen_regions.py.

column5: 68000 exception vector table (hardware consumer): 64 longs; SP 0x10f300, reset PC 0xc00402 (BIOS); the other entries are BIOS 0xc004xx handlers and fixed-P1 handlers 0xe40c-0xe440 (all in the corpus), trap #15 at 0xbc -> 0xe416 (hang), and the remaining 31 longs at 0x80-0xfc (traps 0-14, reserved 0xc0-0xff) are 0

Neo Geo 68k program header (dev wiki layout, field-validated; BIOS 0xc12ffa compares 'NEO-GEO' at 0x100): ID NEO-GEO, system 0x00, NGH word 0x0200 (NGH-200), P-ROM size 0x00200000, backup RAM ptr 0x00100000 size 0x00d4, eye-catcher 0x00/0x68, JP/US/EU soft-DIP pointers 0xda2c/0xdcc8/0xdf64; ends at the USER jmp 0x122. The security-code pointer long at 0x182 is not in this row (see p1_header_pad)
62 zero bytes after p1_vector_tail_zeros up to the security-code pointer at 0x182; no reference (semantic_data_refs: only the value cmpi.l #-$180 at 0x620c2)
Neo Geo header security-code pointer long = 0x00000186, read by BIOS movea.l $182.w at 0xc1300c (sp-s2; must be even, btst #0 at 0xc13012); the MAME tap logs its low word at 0x184 (pc 0xc1300c)

512 zero bytes between the security code [0x186,0x200) (compared word by word by BIOS 0xc13020, last word 0x4e75 at 0x1fe) and the init-node table at 0x400; no address operand into it (index hits are the immediates #$28e/#$3dd/#$200 at 0x4e88/0x4eca/0x4ee8/0x5b160, plain values)

the 5 x {node address, initial node+0 handler} records [0x400,0x428) walked by FUN_00000428: lea ($400,PC),a2 at 0x454, movea.l (a2),a6 at 0x458, move.l ($4,a2),(a6) at 0x4a2, adda.w #8,a2 at 0x4b0, cmpa.l #$1001c0,a6 at 0x4b4 stops after the fifth node 0x1001c0; the nodes are linked into a ring (+4 prev, +8 next, 0x1001c0 -> 0x100100 at 0x4bc); MAME tap, all scenarios: reads by $458/$4a2 over the whole table; ends at code 0x428

terrain slope byte table $9862-$b061 ($1800 bytes) read by terrain_slope_selector: move.b ($9862,PC,d0.w) at 0x9852, d0 = ((map attr & $1fff) - $500)*4 + sub-cell bits 0..3 (map cells $500..$aff; cmpi.w #$600 / bcc at 0x9834/0x9838 rejects the rest), so the index is 0..$17ff; byte = bits 0-1 slope class 0..3, bits 4-7 direction 0..15, bits 2-3 never set (0 of 6144; masked by andi.w #$f3 at 0x9856); its only caller is putt_slope_force $b06a (bsr $981a)

4 longword code pointers (0x5bc66, 0x5bc42, 0x5bc4e, 0x5bc5e); consumer movea.l ($5bc32,PC,d3.w),a1 at 0x5bc2c + jmp (a1) at 0x5bc30; index bounded by andi.w #$60 at 0x5bc26 and lsr.w #3 at 0x5bc2a; entries are block 0005bc42.s; entry 0 (0x5bc66) is the shared tail (no rotation)

binary flag table, all bytes 0x00/0x01; consumed via lea ($5bc98,PC),a0 at 0x5bc20 and tst.b (a0,d0.w) at 0x5bc8a; extent to the next table base (0x2000 spacing); the index x + y*16 + (tile&$f)*$100 + (tile bit 4)*$1000 <= $1fff (0x5bc66-0x5bc86) fixes the $2000 extent; selected by lea at 0x5bc20

binary flag table, all bytes 0x00/0x01 (32 16x16 shapes); terrain_type_query selects it for tile ids $b80-$c7f (subi.w #$b80 / cmpi.w #$100 at 0x5ba24-0x5ba2c, lea ($5dc98,PC) at 0x5bc18) and tests tst.b (a0,d0.w) at 0x5bc8a with d0 = x + 16*y + (id&$f)*$100 + (id bit 4)*$1000 <= $1fff, which fixes the $2000 extent

binary flag table, all bytes 0x00/0x01: five 16x16 shapes (0x500); terrain_type_query selects it for tile ids $b01-$b7f ((id & $f80) == $b00 at 0x5ba36, $b00 itself returns at 0x5ba06; lea ($5fc98,PC) at 0x5bc10) and tests tst.b (a0,d0.w) at 0x5bc8a with the same x + 16*y + (id&$f)*$100 + (id bit 4)*$1000 index; the code bound allows $1fff, so the 0x500 extent (shapes 0-4) rests on the course maps using only such ids with (id & $1f) <= 4; ends at code 0x60198

0x401 longwords, 16.16 fixed point, monotonic 0x00000000->0x00010000 (sin quadrant, index 0x400 = 65536); consumer FUN_0000277e (lea ($f78,PC) at 0x27ae, move.l ($0,a0,d0.w) at 0x27b2, quadrant-folded index 0..0x400)

0x401 words, monotonic 0x0000->0x0200 (atan ratio->angle; entry 0x400 = 0x0200 read when the divu quotient is 0x400); consumer FUN_00002c48 (lea ($1f7c,PC) at 0x2c7c, move.w ($0,a0,d0.w) at 0x2c80, quadrant folding to 0x1000)

0x181 longs, 16.16 t/sqrt(1+t^2) with t = i/444 (fit error <= 2e-5), 0 .. $a776; the next table $3982 holds -1/sqrt(1+t^2). Consumer aim_vector_set $bdc6: index = |sext12(aim_target_angle $10707e - aim_angle $107080)| * 4, lea at $bdfe + move.l at $be04 (-> $102cb4, negated for negative offsets); aim_offset_actor $56582 keeps the offset within +-$180, so entries 0..$180 exactly

16 ascending words 0x0000,0x0220,0x029a..0x0a38,0x0b2c then the 0x7fff sentinel at 0x407c; ball_frame_anim_select 0x3f86: lea ($405c,PC),a2 at 0x3fbc, cmp.w (a2)+,d0 / ble loop at 0x3fc0 against word +$c of current_player_record, d1 = count of entries below it (0..16) picks the 0x40fe sub-table word; also lea $405c.l at 0x7dad6 (same count, clamped to $10)
